title: Enter Relationships
coreMove: Stillness proves itself when your calm makes you more available: you leave room for another person's pace, grief, need, and truth without using them to settle yourself.

exampleSpecs.domain: media class watching a children's television clip
exampleSpecs.audience: teachers and parents who mistake slow attention for weak engagement
exampleSpecs.stakes: A child may learn whether calm attention is offered to them or used to manage them.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Set up the expectation that the 1968 Pittsburgh host will seem too slow, then reveal that the attention lands.

exampleSpecs.domain: short message exchange after seeing a museum display
exampleSpecs.audience: friends learning not to make one person carry the whole inner life
exampleSpecs.stakes: A request for comfort can become a demand for rescue.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use a compressed exchange to show love as an anchor that cannot become the whole floor.

exampleSpecs.domain: bedtime routine interrupted by a child's question
exampleSpecs.audience: caregivers whose routines make them rush past feelings
exampleSpecs.stakes: A repeated household routine can train either hurry or presence.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Interrupt a routine and make the pause itself the relational technique.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers learning through one close detail instead of a live choice
exampleSpecs.stakes: A small object can show how love outlasts a moment and tests a soul.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Describe one lived moment closely with no decision required.

exampleSpecs.domain: team debrief after a failed listening session
exampleSpecs.audience: leaders who borrow calm language while rushing people
exampleSpecs.stakes: A group can quote neighborly attention and still deny it in practice.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Open after failure and locate the decisive misstep.

exampleSpecs.domain: phone call during a grief spiral
exampleSpecs.audience: friends and partners who notice their own demand midstream
exampleSpecs.stakes: A need for comfort can turn another person into a tool.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Make the center of gravity the protagonist noticing her own error.
